outcome: Visual analog scale (VAS) scores for dyspareunia, dysmenorrhea, and pelvic pain
cohort: Symptomatic patients of childbearing age diagnosed with CSD and scheduled for channel-like (360°) hysteroscopic resection
finding: Channel-like (360°) hysteroscopic resection for symptomatic CSD led to increased RMT, decreased CSD size, improved symptoms, and high patient satisfaction.
